proposed_rules.trigger: A text node whose content is raw PHP serialized-array syntax (e.g. starts with 'a:N:{s:...' / WordPress ACF field-repeater dump), rendered visibly due to a template/escaping bug.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from content and section analysis; it is a source-leak artifact analogous to leaked-css-text-node, not authorable page content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same class of bug as the already-confirmed leaked-css-text-node rule (raw source rendered into the page), just a different leaking source (WordPress/ACF serialized data instead of CSS).

proposed_rules.trigger: An identical ~453px band at the very bottom of the page reading 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a small social-icon row, recurring unchanged across unrelated templates (download, integration, ebook-category).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a site-wide footer fragment rendered on every page, not as per-page authored content. Alternative rejected: treating it as a normal page-ending CTA section authored per page (rejected because content and layout are byte-identical across templates, indicating global chrome rather than page content).
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical text/size across independently themed templates strongly indicates a shared footer/fragment injected site-wide rather than page-authored content.

provenance.evidence: C88 rc2 identical to same node in C84/C85/C86/C87

proposed_rules.trigger: A category/facet filter chip bar with a 'Clear All' control sitting above a repeating card listing (as opposed to a static content grid).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a 'category-filter' block that ships JS-driven filtering behavior, distinct from the card-grid block it filters. Alternative rejected: folding the filter chips into the card-grid block itself (rejected because the filter is a reusable interactive control, not per-item content, and should be authorable/reusable independently).
proposed_rules.rationale: Filter UI is a functional widget rather than static content, and separating it keeps the card-grid block reusable on pages without filtering.

provenance.evidence: C88 rc1c2c2c1c1 [4x2] chip bar + rc1c2c2c1c2 'Clear All'

notes: Category listing page: nav, mis-labeled heading zone with a leaked serialized-data artifact, category filter bar, 3x3 ebook card grid with load-more, an empty trailing gradient zone (flagged per underrendered-list-zone), and the recurring bottom banner.
